news.title: News
news.content:
Imagine you need to use an app to record your attendance using your face. First, the system shows you a box on the screen so you know exactly where to place your face. As you adjust, it turns green to let you know you're ready.

It's important to be in a well-lit place. Once your face looks good, the system asks for a small gesture, like blinking or moving your head slightly, to ensure it's not a photo or something fake.

The best part is that the scan doesn't take long, just about two or three seconds, and immediately a clear message appears on the screen saying whether attendance was recorded successfully or if there was any problem. Everything is designed to be fast and simple.
